findings.summary: The firm overviews describe past engagements with the wrong service type, contradicting every other document in those same engagement folders.
findings.evidence: Firm Overview 2007 (d:0040) says of Peck-Jennings 'we are carrying the stormwater and roadway design now', but E-2007-001 is the Peck-Jennings Bridge Deck Rehabilitation in its letter, kickoff, minutes, and status report (d:0036/d:0037/d:0038/d:0039). The same overview calls the Evans-Lee Roadway Widening Study 'a drainage study', and both the 2004 and 2007 overviews (d:0021, d:0040) call the Johnson PLC Stormwater Management Plan 'roadway and utility design'. A reader opening any client folder finds the firm's own overview naming the wrong discipline for that job.
